title: Alam hamara hai
body:
Alam hamara hai
Ye jo panja hai ek balandi par..(2)
hai ye shane alam sare manzar
sar balandi ka ek ishara hai
ye jo mashkiza e sakina hai
pyaase bacho'n ka ye safina hai
ashiqo'n, saaya e dua me chalo
haan chalo bazme bawafa me chalo
